cards.ex: She's set her sights on becoming a doctor.
cards.exUz: U shifokor bo'lishni maqsad qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir erishishni qattiq xohlamoq, maqsad qilib belgilamoq.

cards.ex: I have a yearning for adventure.
cards.exUz: Menda sarguzashtga ishtiyoq bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir juda kuchli xohish yoki sog'inch his qilish.

cards.ex: He aspires to be a great writer.
cards.exUz: U buyuk yozuvchi bo'lishga intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori maqsadga erishishga harakat qilmoq, umid qilmoq.

cards.ex: She has a strong drive to succeed in business.
cards.exUz: Uning biznesda muvaffaqiyat qozonish uchun kuchli intilishi bor.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun kuchli ichki motivatsiya.

cards.ex: He had a burning desire to travel the world.
cards.exUz: Uning dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilish uchun yonayotgan istagi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli, to'xtovsiz xohish.

cards.ex: I dream of owning a house by the sea.
cards.exUz: Men dengiz bo'yida uyga ega bo'lishni orzu qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Katta orzular bilan hayol qilmoq, ko'pincha kelajak haqida.

cards.ex: She's a real go-getter, always looking for new opportunities.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy harakatchan, doimo yangi imkoniyatlarni qidiradi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun faol harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: She has her heart set on winning the competition.
cards.exUz: Uning musobaqada g'alaba qozonish qalbida bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimani juda xohlamoq, butun qalb bilan istamoq.

cards.ex: I long for the days when we were carefree.
cards.exUz: Men beparvo bo'lgan kunlarni sog'inaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir kuchli sog'inch bilan intilmoq.

cards.ex: I think he's bitten off more than he can chew with this project.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, u bu loyiha bilan qo'lidan kelmas ishga urindi.
cards.term: bite off more than you can chew
cards.uzDef: Qobiliyatidan ortiqcha ishni o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: They always told me to reach for the stars, no matter what.
cards.exUz: Ular menga har doim, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, yulduzlarga intilishni aytishgan.
cards.uzDef: Katta orzular qilib, ularga erishishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: He's determined to climb the ladder in his company.
cards.exUz: U o'z kompaniyasida zinadan ko'tarilishga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Ishda yoki hayotda yuqori lavozimlarga erishmoq.

cards.ex: She has a real thirst for knowledge and loves to learn new things.
cards.exUz: Uning bilimga chanqoqligi bor va yangi narsalarni o'rganishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Bilim olishga bo'lgan kuchli xohish.

cards.ex: Our company strives for excellence in everything we do.
cards.exUz: Bizning kompaniyamiz har bir ishda mukammallikka intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Doimo eng yaxshi natijalarga erishishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: She's a very ambitious young woman.
cards.exUz: U juda maqsadli yosh ayol.
cards.uzDef: Katta maqsadlarga ega bo'lgan va ularga erishishga intiladigan.

cards.ex: He's a driven individual who always achieves his goals.
cards.exUz: U doimo o'z maqsadlariga erishadigan intiluvchan shaxs.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun kuchli motivatsiyaga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He's always eager to please his boss.
cards.exUz: U doimo boshlig'iga yoqishga tayyor.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga yoqishga qattiq harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: We have high hopes for the success of this project.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu loyihaning muvaffaqiyatiga katta umid qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir juda katta natijalar kutmoq.

cards.ex: They encourage their students to aim high in their studies.
cards.exUz: Ular o'quvchilarini o'qishlarida yuqori nishonlashga undashadi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi natijalarga erishishni maqsad qilmoq.

cards.ex: He was known as a man of ambition and determination.
cards.exUz: U maqsadli va qat'iyatli inson sifatida tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Katta maqsadlarga erishishga intiladigan erkak.

cards.ex: She had to grit her teeth and get through the difficult times.
cards.exUz: U tishini tishiga qo'yib, qiyin kunlardan o'tishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga bardosh berish uchun qat'iyat bilan harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: You need to keep your eye on the ball if you want to succeed.
cards.exUz: Agar muvaffaqiyatga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, asosiyga e'tibor qaratishingiz kerak.
cards.term: keep your eye on the ball
cards.uzDef: Muhim narsaga e'tiborni yo'qotmaslik, diqqatni jamlamoq.

cards.ex: He's hungry for success and will do whatever it takes to get there.
cards.exUz: U muvaffaqiyatga tashna va u erga yetish uchun hamma narsani qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishishga bo'lgan kuchli xohish.

cards.ex: After years of hard work, he's finally living the dream.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik mehnatdan so'ng, u nihoyat orzular bilan yashayapti.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri orzu qilingan hayotni yashamoq.

cards.ex: She's on a mission to raise awareness about climate change.
cards.exUz: U iqlim o'zgarishi haqida xabardorlikni oshirish vazifasida.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir maqsadga erishish uchun qat'iy harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: He has a passion for music and plays the piano every day.
cards.exUz: Uning musiqaga ishtiyoqi bor va har kuni pianino chaladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir kuchli qiziqish va xohish.

cards.ex: You need to push yourself if you want to improve.
cards.exUz: Agar yaxshilanmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'zingizni majburlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z imkoniyatlaringizdan ko'proq harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: She's intent on finishing her degree this year.
cards.exUz: U bu yil diplomini olishga qasd qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Nimani aniq maqsad qilib, unga erishishga qat'iy qaror qilmoq.

cards.ex: I'm going to have a go at learning to play the guitar.
cards.exUz: Men gitara chalishni o'rganishga urinib ko'rmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga harakat qilib ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: We want to help our students reach their full potential.
cards.exUz: Biz o'quvchilarimizga to'liq salohiyatlariga erishishga yordam bermoqchimiz.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizdagi eng yaxshi natijalarga erishmoq.
